ops_jobs_per_unit.notes: JEDI wind O&M: 0.21 FTE/MW direct employment. × 1000 MW unit_scale.

school_finance_net_total.source: Wyoming Block Grant Estimated Payment Details, FY2025 WDE Funding Model Version 3(d)
school_finance_net_total.notes: net_flow = entitlement_amount - recapture_amount, aggregated from district to county via 6-mill (82110/82111) cross-county weights. Four cross-county clusters: Big Horn/Park, Lincoln/Sublette, Goshen/Niobrara/Platte, Carbon/Sweetwater. Negative = county districts are net recapture contributors to state. Supersedes 37-mill proxy (confidence was: low).

school_finance_mineral_share.source: Wyoming School District Locally Collected Revenues, WDE
school_finance_mineral_share.notes: Numerator: sum of all mineral-attributed 25-mill and 6-mill estimates (deferred + PY2024 + PY2025 from cols a+b+e+f+g+h of District Locally Collected Revenues). Denominator: Total Estimated FY2025 25&6-mill Tax Collections (col 59). Some counties (Campbell, Converse) have PY2024=0 with PY2025 holding the mineral estimates due to billing/assessment timing. Total across all periods gives correct mineral fraction. Stored as informational field — not blended into net_flow.

Denominator: Total Estimated FY2025 25&6-mill Tax Collections (col 59). Some counties (Campbell, Converse) have PY2024=0 with PY2025 holding the mineral estimates due to billing/assessment timing. Total across all periods gives correct mineral fraction. Stored as informational field — not blended into net_flow.

school_finance_net_total.source: Wyoming Block Grant Estimated Payment Details, FY2025 WDE Funding Model Version 3(d)
school_finance_net_total.notes: net_flow = entitlement_amount - recapture_amount, aggregated from district to county via 6-mill (82110/82111) cross-county weights. Four cross-county clusters: Big Horn/Park, Lincoln/Sublette, Goshen/Niobrara/Platte, Carbon/Sweetwater. Negative = county districts are net recapture contributors to state. Supersedes 37-mill proxy (confidence was: low).

56001.unit: USD/yr per MW coal retired (annual severance tax distribution reduction)
56001.source: PRB_COAL_TONS_PER_MW_YR: EIA Form 923 (WY coal heat rate 10500 BTU/kWh) × EIA Annual Coal Report (PRB HHV 8600 BTU/lb) × 0.70 CF; severance_rate: $132,418,277 coal surface / 233M tons (EIA 2023) = $0.568/ton; dist_share: county_coal_prod_val / statewide_coal_prod_val; W.S. 39-14-204 (coal severance); W.S. 39-14-211 (distribution formula)
56001.lag: Severance distributions follow production with approximately 1-year lag (W.S. 39-14-211 distribution timing).
56001.notes: Null #3: Effective severance rate back-calculated from statewide coal surface collections ($132,418,277) / WY production (233M tons). Statutory rate (W.S. 39-14-204): 7% of taxable value after deductions. Low effective rate reflects transportation/processing deductions. County coal distribution share uses coal-specific proxy (null #1 applied).

school_finance_net_total.source: Wyoming Block Grant Estimated Payment Details, FY2025 WDE Funding Model Version 3(d)
school_finance_net_total.notes: net_flow = entitlement_amount - recapture_amount, aggregated from district to county via 6-mill (82110/82111) cross-county weights. Four cross-county clusters: Big Horn/Park, Lincoln/Sublette, Goshen/Niobrara/Platte, Carbon/Sweetwater. Negative = county districts are net recapture contributors to state. Supersedes 37-mill proxy (confidence was: low).

school_finance_mineral_share.source: Wyoming School District Locally Collected Revenues, WDE
school_finance_mineral_share.notes: Numerator: sum of all mineral-attributed 25-mill and 6-mill estimates (deferred + PY2024 + PY2025 from cols a+b+e+f+g+h of District Locally Collected Revenues). Denominator: Total Estimated FY2025 25&6-mill Tax Collections (col 59). Some counties (Campbell, Converse) have PY2024=0 with PY2025 holding the mineral estimates due to billing/assessment timing. Total across all periods gives correct mineral fraction. Stored as informational field — not blended into net_flow.

school_finance_net_total.source: Wyoming Block Grant Estimated Payment Details, FY2025 WDE Funding Model Version 3(d)
school_finance_net_total.notes: net_flow = entitlement_amount - recapture_amount, aggregated from district to county via 6-mill (82110/82111) cross-county weights. Four cross-county clusters: Big Horn/Park, Lincoln/Sublette, Goshen/Niobrara/Platte, Carbon/Sweetwater. Negative = county districts are net recapture contributors to state. Supersedes 37-mill proxy (confidence was: low).

school_finance_mineral_share.source: Wyoming School District Locally Collected Revenues, WDE
school_finance_mineral_share.notes: Numerator: sum of all mineral-attributed 25-mill and 6-mill estimates (deferred + PY2024 + PY2025 from cols a+b+e+f+g+h of District Locally Collected Revenues). Denominator: Total Estimated FY2025 25&6-mill Tax Collections (col 59). Some counties (Campbell, Converse) have PY2024=0 with PY2025 holding the mineral estimates due to billing/assessment timing. Total across all periods gives correct mineral fraction. Stored as informational field — not blended into net_flow.

Four cross-county clusters: Big Horn/Park, Lincoln/Sublette, Goshen/Niobrara/Platte, Carbon/Sweetwater. Negative = county districts are net recapture contributors to state. Supersedes 37-mill proxy (confidence was: low).

school_finance_mineral_share.source: Wyoming School District Locally Collected Revenues, WDE
school_finance_mineral_share.notes: Numerator: sum of all mineral-attributed 25-mill and 6-mill estimates (deferred + PY2024 + PY2025 from cols a+b+e+f+g+h of District Locally Collected Revenues). Denominator: Total Estimated FY2025 25&6-mill Tax Collections (col 59). Some counties (Campbell, Converse) have PY2024=0 with PY2025 holding the mineral estimates due to billing/assessment timing. Total across all periods gives correct mineral fraction. Stored as informational field — not blended into net_flow.

Supersedes 37-mill proxy (confidence was: low).

school_finance_mineral_share.source: Wyoming School District Locally Collected Revenues, WDE

Total across all periods gives correct mineral fraction. Stored as informational field — not blended into net_flow.

56041.lag: Severance distributions follow production with approximately 1-year lag (W.S. 39-14-211 distribution timing).
56041.notes: Null #3: Effective severance rate back-calculated from statewide coal surface collections ($132,418,277) / WY production (233M tons). Statutory rate (W.S. 39-14-204): 7% of taxable value after deductions. Low effective rate reflects transportation/processing deductions. County coal distribution share uses coal-specific proxy (null #1 applied).

school_finance_net_total.source: Wyoming Block Grant Estimated Payment Details, FY2025 WDE Funding Model Version 3(d)
school_finance_net_total.notes: net_flow = entitlement_amount - recapture_amount, aggregated from district to county via 6-mill (82110/82111) cross-county weights. Supersedes 37-mill proxy (confidence was: low).

school_finance_mineral_share.source: Wyoming School District Locally Collected Revenues, WDE
school_finance_mineral_share.notes: Numerator: sum of all mineral-attributed 25-mill and 6-mill estimates (deferred + PY2024 + PY2025 from cols a+b+e+f+g+h of District Locally Collected Revenues). Denominator: Total Estimated FY2025 25&6-mill Tax Collections (col 59). Some counties (Campbell, Converse) have PY2024=0 with PY2025 holding the mineral estimates due to billing/assessment timing. Total across all periods gives correct mineral fraction. Stored as informational field — not blended into net_flow.

Total across all periods gives correct mineral fraction. Stored as informational field — not blended into net_flow.

school_finance_net_total.source: Wyoming Block Grant Estimated Payment Details, FY2025 WDE Funding Model Version 3(d)
school_finance_net_total.notes: net_flow = entitlement_amount - recapture_amount, aggregated from district to county via 6-mill (82110/82111) cross-county weights. Four cross-county clusters: Big Horn/Park, Lincoln/Sublette, Goshen/Niobrara/Platte, Carbon/Sweetwater. Negative = county districts are net recapture contributors to state. Supersedes 37-mill proxy (confidence was: low).

school_finance_mineral_share.source: Wyoming School District Locally Collected Revenues, WDE
school_finance_mineral_share.notes: Numerator: sum of all mineral-attributed 25-mill and 6-mill estimates (deferred + PY2024 + PY2025 from cols a+b+e+f+g+h of District Locally Collected Revenues). Denominator: Total Estimated FY2025 25&6-mill Tax Collections (col 59). Some counties (Campbell, Converse) have PY2024=0 with PY2025 holding the mineral estimates due to billing/assessment timing. Total across all periods gives correct mineral fraction. Stored as informational field — not blended into net_flow.

Denominator: Total Estimated FY2025 25&6-mill Tax Collections (col 59). Some counties (Campbell, Converse) have PY2024=0 with PY2025 holding the mineral estimates due to billing/assessment timing. Total across all periods gives correct mineral fraction. Stored as informational field — not blended into net_flow.

school_finance_net_total.source: Wyoming Block Grant Estimated Payment Details, FY2025 WDE Funding Model Version 3(d)
school_finance_net_total.notes: net_flow = entitlement_amount - recapture_amount, aggregated from district to county via 6-mill (82110/82111) cross-county weights. Four cross-county clusters: Big Horn/Park, Lincoln/Sublette, Goshen/Niobrara/Platte, Carbon/Sweetwater. Negative = county districts are net recapture contributors to state. Supersedes 37-mill proxy (confidence was: low).

ops_jobs_per_unit.source: NRC licensing filings for WY ISR uranium mines; WY DEQ uranium mining permits (2022-2024)
ops_jobs_per_unit.notes: WY ISR mines typically 30-80 permanent FTE. Midpoint 50.

school_finance_net_total.source: Wyoming Block Grant Estimated Payment Details, FY2025 WDE Funding Model Version 3(d)
school_finance_net_total.notes: net_flow = entitlement_amount - recapture_amount, aggregated from district to county via 6-mill (82110/82111) cross-county weights. Four cross-county clusters: Big Horn/Park, Lincoln/Sublette, Goshen/Niobrara/Platte, Carbon/Sweetwater. Negative = county districts are net recapture contributors to state. Supersedes 37-mill proxy (confidence was: low).

school_finance_mineral_share.source: Wyoming School District Locally Collected Revenues, WDE
school_finance_mineral_share.notes: Numerator: sum of all mineral-attributed 25-mill and 6-mill estimates (deferred + PY2024 + PY2025 from cols a+b+e+f+g+h of District Locally Collected Revenues). Denominator: Total Estimated FY2025 25&6-mill Tax Collections (col 59). Some counties (Campbell, Converse) have PY2024=0 with PY2025 holding the mineral estimates due to billing/assessment timing. Total across all periods gives correct mineral fraction. Stored as informational field — not blended into net_flow.

school_finance_net_total.source: Wyoming Block Grant Estimated Payment Details, FY2025 WDE Funding Model Version 3(d)
school_finance_net_total.notes: net_flow = entitlement_amount - recapture_amount, aggregated from district to county via 6-mill (82110/82111) cross-county weights. school_finance_mineral_share.notes: Numerator: sum of all mineral-attributed 25-mill and 6-mill estimates (deferred + PY2024 + PY2025 from cols a+b+e+f+g+h of District Locally Collected Revenues). Four cross-county clusters: Big Horn/Park, Lincoln/Sublette, Goshen/Niobrara/Platte, Carbon/Sweetwater. Negative = county districts are net recapture contributors to state. Supersedes 37-mill proxy (confidence was: low).

school_finance_mineral_share.source: Wyoming School District Locally Collected Revenues, WDE
school_finance_mineral_share.notes: Numerator: sum of all mineral-attributed 25-mill and 6-mill estimates (deferred + PY2024 + PY2025 from cols a+b+e+f+g+h of District Locally Collected Revenues). Denominator: Total Estimated FY2025 25&6-mill Tax Collections (col 59). Some counties (Campbell, Converse) have PY2024=0 with PY2025 holding the mineral estimates due to billing/assessment timing. Total across all periods gives correct mineral fraction. Stored as informational field — not blended into net_flow.

Four cross-county clusters: Big Horn/Park, Lincoln/Sublette, Goshen/Niobrara/Platte, Carbon/Sweetwater. Negative = county districts are net recapture contributors to state. Supersedes 37-mill proxy (confidence was: low).

school_finance_mineral_share.source: Wyoming School District Locally Collected Revenues, WDE
school_finance_mineral_share.notes: Numerator: sum of all mineral-attributed 25-mill and 6-mill estimates (deferred + PY2024 + PY2025 from cols a+b+e+f+g+h of District Locally Collected Revenues). Denominator: Total Estimated FY2025 25&6-mill Tax Collections (col 59). Some counties (Campbell, Converse) have PY2024=0 with PY2025 holding the mineral estimates due to billing/assessment timing. Total across all periods gives correct mineral fraction. Stored as informational field — not blended into net_flow.

Denominator: Total Estimated FY2025 25&6-mill Tax Collections (col 59). Some counties (Campbell, Converse) have PY2024=0 with PY2025 holding the mineral estimates due to billing/assessment timing. Total across all periods gives correct mineral fraction. Stored as informational field — not blended into net_flow.

Supersedes 37-mill proxy (confidence was: low).

Supersedes 37-mill proxy (confidence was: low).

school_finance_mineral_share.source: Wyoming School District Locally Collected Revenues, WDE

Total across all periods gives correct mineral fraction. Stored as informational field — not blended into net_flow.

school_finance_net_total.source: Wyoming Block Grant Estimated Payment Details, FY2025 WDE Funding Model Version 3(d)
school_finance_net_total.notes: net_flow = entitlement_amount - recapture_amount, aggregated from district to county via 6-mill (82110/82111) cross-county weights. Four cross-county clusters: Big Horn/Park, Lincoln/Sublette, Goshen/Niobrara/Platte, Carbon/Sweetwater. Negative = county districts are net recapture contributors to state. Supersedes 37-mill proxy (confidence was: low).

school_finance_mineral_share.source: Wyoming School District Locally Collected Revenues, WDE
school_finance_mineral_share.notes: Numerator: sum of all mineral-attributed 25-mill and 6-mill estimates (deferred + PY2024 + PY2025 from cols a+b+e+f+g+h of District Locally Collected Revenues). Denominator: Total Estimated FY2025 25&6-mill Tax Collections (col 59). Some counties (Campbell, Converse) have PY2024=0 with PY2025 holding the mineral estimates due to billing/assessment timing. Total across all periods gives correct mineral fraction. Stored as informational field — not blended into net_flow.

Four cross-county clusters: Big Horn/Park, Lincoln/Sublette, Goshen/Niobrara/Platte, Carbon/Sweetwater. Negative = county districts are net recapture contributors to state. Supersedes 37-mill proxy (confidence was: low).

school_finance_mineral_share.source: Wyoming School District Locally Collected Revenues, WDE
school_finance_mineral_share.notes: Numerator: sum of all mineral-attributed 25-mill and 6-mill estimates (deferred + PY2024 + PY2025 from cols a+b+e+f+g+h of District Locally Collected Revenues). Denominator: Total Estimated FY2025 25&6-mill Tax Collections (col 59). Some counties (Campbell, Converse) have PY2024=0 with PY2025 holding the mineral estimates due to billing/assessment timing. Total across all periods gives correct mineral fraction. Stored as informational field — not blended into net_flow.

_ag_fiscal_coefficients._schema_note: AG1 ag fiscal coefficients. References existing 11.5%-FMV industrial pipeline for conversion delta — does not duplicate it. Net shown as property-tax INCREASE because ag-to-industrial conversion almost always raises assessed value substantially.

ag_productive_value_by_class_usd_per_acr.source: WY DOR 2026 Agricultural Land Valuation Study; wyo-prop-div.wyo.gov

conversion_delta_to_industrial.description: When ag land is converted to industrial use (e.g., solar farm, transmission ROW), the assessed value changes from ag (9.5% × productive value) to industrial (11.5% × FMV). The delta is almost always a LARGE INCREASE. FMV proxies for industrial are action-specific (see wy_fiscal_coefficients.json per-action blocks). This coefficient encodes the ag-side baseline only.
conversion_delta_to_industrial.industrial_pipeline_reference: See existing action blocks (wind_utility, solar_utility, etc.) in wy_fiscal_coefficients.json for the industrial assessed_delta_usd values. Net property-tax delta = industrial_assessed_delta - ag_assessed_baseline.
conversion_delta_to_industrial.net_direction: INCREASE — ag assessed value is typically orders of magnitude below industrial FMV.

example_irrigated_vs_wind.note: Wind industrial assessed ($164.5M) >> 250 acres ag assessed (~$41.9K irrigated). Net = +$164.4M increase.

conversion_delta_to_industrial.source: WY DOR 2026 Ag Valuation Study (ag side); W.S. 39-13-103 (industrial side); existing wy_fiscal_coefficients.json per-action blocks.
